product.title: Drift Fishing Trip off the Coast of Fort Lauderdale

description.text: Offered in the morning, afternoon, and evening, the 4-hour excursion can suit any schedule. Use a provided pole to reel in grouper, porgies, snapper, and more. Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Fort Lauderdale's waterways and coastal wildlife. Ideal for anglers departing Fort Lauderdale who want a crew-managed offshore fishing window.
